summary: Post-refactor verification (backend split: server.py + helpers.py + models.py + deps.py; frontend split: App.js + lib/* + components/* + pages/*). Backend: all 84 existing pytest tests PASS (62.9s). Added 14 new refactor smoke tests covering every endpoint called out in review (scraper/schedule, products list+archived+search, global search, portal register/login/me/orders, orders CRUD + status cycle pending->processing->shipped->delivered, notifications, push settings, push test, analytics overview + report) — 14/14 PASS. Frontend: dashboard + all 10 sidebar nav destinations render with zero console errors; global search dropdown returns 1 product + 3 orders for 'AF21' (data-testids search-product-* / search-order-*); notification bell shows 25 notifications and deep-link click opens ProductDetail/OrderDetail; Customer Portal login as aliko@yopmail.com/secret123 succeeds and renders exactly 3 order cards (Pending / Paid / Delivered) with correct review-gating (Write-a-review CTA on paid+delivered, 'Review available once processed' on pending). Refactor did NOT introduce regressions.

issues: React hydration warning: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' still present in Select components — non-blocking.
Recharts 'width(-1) height(-1)' warnings on first paint of dashboard — cosmetic.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py at 1862 lines is still above the 700-line guideline — consider a further router-level split (products.py / orders.py / portal.py / analytics.py) but non-blocking; endpoint boundaries are already clean.
OrderCreate model accepts only single product_id + quantity (no line-items array) — fine given current UI, but if the storefront ever needs multi-line orders this will need to evolve.
Product/Order/Notification list endpoints return a paginated envelope {items[], total}. Previous test assumed bare lists — envelope shape is fine and consistent, just document it.
Two on_event(startup/shutdown) usages in server.py trigger DeprecationWarnings — migrate to lifespan handlers when convenient.
test_credentials: Customer Portal: aliko@yopmail.com / secret123 (already registered — 3 seeded orders).
seed_data_creation: Ephemeral TEST_cycle_* orders created and immediately deleted inside status-cycle test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend list endpoints return {products|orders|notifications: [...], total: N} envelopes — not bare arrays. OrderCreate schema requires top-level product_id + quantity (not items[]). aliko@yopmail.com has 3 orders with statuses pending/paid/delivered — the write-review CTA only renders on paid+delivered per business rule. Portal testids: portal-email, portal-password, portal-submit, portal-tab-login/register, portal-order-<oid>, portal-write-review-<oid>, portal-signout, portal-dashboard. Global search testids: global-search-input, global-search-dropdown, search-product-<pid>, search-order-<oid>.
rca of the issue: No issues found — refactor is clean.
